items.title: The New Alfred Hitchcock Presents (1985-1989)
items.description: This rarity is hard to come by & I wanted to do my best to make sure it is archived, because it seems we will never see this released again. These are mainly Chiller TV rips. For those of you who do not know, this is a remake series of Alfred Hitchcock's original show.
